trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Read in full (volume table, conjecture statement, remark, scope section, two reduction paragraphs, closing scope paragraph). Judged all ten categories on the whole text.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: VERIFIED: Vol(4_1) = 2 Cl_2(pi/3) = 2.0298832128 (stated ~2.02988, correct); Vol(5_2) = 2.8281220883 (stated ~2.82812, correct); Vol(Borromean) = 7.3277247534 (stated ~7.32772, correct); 'all torus knots have zero hyperbolic volume' is correct (torus knots are not hyperbolic); Reid 1991 -- 4_1 the unique arithmetic hyperbolic knot, commensurable with PSL_2(O_3) -- is correctly stated, 5_2 is non-arithmetic by that uniqueness, and pairwise non-commensurability follows from the distinct invariant trace fields Q(sqrt-3), the cubic field of 5_2, and Q(i). TWO DEFECTS reported, not fixed: (1) the volume table's third column reads 'Figure-eight 4_1 | Higgs BOSON', contradicting the corpus's own explicit disambiguation -- knot-formula-table.md, a sibling in this same chapter, says 'The Higgs FIELD (mass mechanism) is the figure-eight knot 4_1... The Higgs BOSON excitation (~125 GeV) is the torus link T(2,8)', and electroweak-higgs-torus-link-triplet.md states it flatly. Numerically decisive: Vol(4_1)/hbar_q^2 = 206.77, which is m_mu/m_e, not 125 GeV. (2) the display chain 'irrationality <= Q-linear independence <= algebraic independence' -- the right arrow is valid, the LEFT one is not as stated: Q-linear independence of a SET does not imply its members are irrational unless 1 is adjoined ({1/2, pi, e} is Q-linearly independent with a rational member). The sibling block implications-algebraic-independence derives irrationality from ALGEBRAIC independence, which IS valid; only this chain's middle link needs '1 adjoined'.
